title: Corgi Labs vs Riskified
summary: Compare Corgi Labs and Riskified. Corgi Labs builds a model on your own payments and runs it alongside Riskified, so you see the lift before you switch.
body_markdown:
THE SHORT ANSWER


## Three differences that matter


Riskified learns from its global merchant network. Corgi Labs is built around one merchant: you.


-


### A model built on your data


Riskified draws on over a billion prior transactions. Corgi Labs trains a model on your own transaction history.


-


### Proof before you switch


Corgi Labs runs alongside Riskified on your payments and reports the lift against a real holdout period.


-


### Pricing tied to results


Riskified charges for approved orders and covers chargebacks. Corgi Labs pricing is a share of the revenue lift it adds.


AT A GLANCE


## Corgi Labs and Riskified compared


What each one learns from, how results are proven, and how pricing works.


### Riskified


-


Draws on over a billion prior transactions


-


Approval and chargeback guarantee


-


Reports up to 20% higher approval rates


-


Pay only for approved orders


-


Policy Protect for returns and promo abuse


### Corgi Labs


-


A model trained on **your own transactions**


-


**Custom** to your business and customers


-


**Proven on your history** before it goes live


-


**Pricing tied to the lift** , no fixed platform fee


-


**Free diagnostic** on read-only access


Source: Riskified details from[riskified.com](https://www.riskified.com/) and[riskified.com/chargeback-guarantee](https://www.riskified.com/chargeback-guarantee/) , checked 27 Oct 2026.

HOW SWITCHING WORKS


## Run Corgi Labs alongside Riskified


Keep Riskified live while Corgi Labs proves the lift on your own payments. Switch when the numbers say so.


1.


01


### Connect


Connect your payment processor and history.


2.


02


### Backtest


We train a model on your history and show what it would have caught.


3.


03


### Run alongside


Corgi Labs scores the same payments as Riskified without touching live traffic.


4.


04


### Switch


Once the lift is proven, Corgi Labs takes over live approve and block decisions.


5.


05


### Improve


The model keeps learning from your newest payments.


WHEN RISKIFIED IS ENOUGH


## When Riskified is the better fit


Corgi Labs isn’t the right call for every merchant.


-


### Low payment volume


A custom model needs enough of your own payment history to learn from.


-


### You want a chargeback guarantee


Riskified covers chargebacks on the orders it approves. Corgi Labs prices on the lift it adds instead.


-


### Policy abuse is the bigger problem


Riskified Policy Protect targets refund, returns and promo abuse.
